# unifi_access_door (Data Source)

Look up a UniFi Access door by `id` (`unique_id`) or `name` (read-only). Use it to obtain a door's id for `unifi_access_door_group` / `unifi_access_door` / `unifi_access_door_guard`. **Modeled from the undocumented Access API and not yet verified against a live console — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Access object id (`unique_id`). Provide `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Door display name. Provide `name` or `id`. If multiple doors share a name, the first match wins.

### Read-Only

- `dps_connected` (Boolean) Whether a door-position sensor is connected (live state).
- `extra_type` (String) Door type tag.
- `floor_id` (String) `unique_id` of the door's parent floor.
- `full_name` (String) Full location path of the door.
- `is_open` (Boolean) Whether the door is currently open (live state).
- `location_type` (String) Location type of the door.
- `timezone` (String) Door timezone.
